edgeSpeedLimits.description: Optional mapped posted limit for each geometry edge; length must equal points length minus one. Null means unknown. Profile or calculated routing speeds are forbidden.

remainingPlan.description: Authenticated edit request. The phone fixes origin to its freshly acknowledged held point and validates phase/radio ownership. An airborne suffix omits the completed departure road geometry.

remainingPreview.description: An applied remaining flight has ordered suffix roles: DEPARTURE/AIR/ARRIVAL, AIR/ARRIVAL, or ARRIVAL. Completed geometry is never resurrected.
